Boolector
Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Boolector/boolector/3.2.3/COPYING
Boolector is a Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) Solver for bit-vectors,
arrays and uninterpreted functions.

Copyright (C) 2007-2021 by its authors and contributors and their institutional
affiliations as listed in file AUTHORS.
